column1: # testees/pcrec/list_limits.tsv -- pcrec's NUMERIC-LIMITS TABLE at the pin
# docs/spec/table_contract.md), archived VERBATIM under a source header.
# Everything below this header is the unmodified output of:
# pcrec commit 5ff21faca9e8fa0d82eb35a6c0a333ec84c904c3 (rx_info.abi 65, read off a plain `abc` witness at this build),
# archived 2026-10-07 by lane b124prep ([B124] RE-PIN PREP: pcrec
# fixes over main e6e6d6eb + [MEMFN] R4c; SIX abi steps, list_axes.tsv's
# header states each. A PREP pin: the final [B124] pin is named by inbox
# 72 data rows / 7 columns -- BYTE-IDENTICAL to the c4c70f2c archive
# (diffed line for line): no step 60-65 adds a numeric limit.
# SIXTH TSV surface; D90/[LIM-1]). One row per numeric limit in
# src/core/limits.def, in the table's own order.
# unit: the quantity's dimension, or empty for a dimensionless
# kind: "compile budget" (bounds the COMPILER's own analysis or
#   emission; crossing it can refuse a pattern) | "runtime
#   capacity" (bounds the EMITTED MATCHER's own resource use;
#   crossing it is a give-up, never a wrong answer) | "size cap"
#   threshold or default that steers a selection mechanism, not a
#   hard ceiling) | "identifier cap" (bounds a name's length or a
# override: "flag" (a CLI flag or pcrec_options field moves it per
#   compile) | "-D" (only a build-time -D at pcrec's OWN compile
#   moves it, never a caller lever) | "flag+-D" (BOTH: a caller
#   flag moves it per compile AND a build-time -D moves the
#   built-in default the flag's own floor is measured against) |
# anchor: the docs/spec/limits.md section this number is
#   documented in, empty when it is not (limits.md states caller-
#   facing PROMISES, not an internals catalogue — see this file's
#   own header and src/core/limits.def's for the boundary).

column7: desc
generated-symbol prefix (-p): a C identifier bound
K38: fixed buffer size for every emitted identifier/sub-expression built from the -p prefix
[SEL-1]: fixed size of the DFA-cap-overflow reason string (RX_ENGINE_WHY source)
M2.8: NFA state-count ceiling; a memory backstop, the DFA caps below usually bind first; --max-nfa-states ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only)

computed-goto DFA attempt engine's state ceiling; --max-dfa-states-goto ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only) -- raising it trades gcc's own superlinear computed-goto compile time (R1 A-3), the caller's cost to accept

table-engine DFA state ceiling; NOT RAISABLE (N1 survey) -- the emitted table's cell type is a C `short`/`unsigned short` (PREMUL_DEAD=65535, indexed dead=-1; src/gen/emit_dfa.c), so a state number the artifact cannot represent would silently truncate; 32000 already sits just under that ceiling
states*classes bound on the DFA transition table (~12 MB source)
[M4.7b]/K7: total NFA-state-list elements the priority subset construction may intern, summed over both machines; --max-subset-elems ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only)

[LIM-2] N1: the AUTO route's own DFA-attempt work budget, in K7's already-counted subset-element unit (Ctx.subset_elems); over budget under --engine=auto abandons the attempt and falls back to VM through the SAME auto-fallback umbrella a PCREC_MAX_SUBSET_ELEMS refusal uses (SEL-1); --engine=dfa is unaffected and pays the full cap above; --max-auto-dfa-elems ALSO raises it per compile (raise-only); -D moves the built-in default (the N1 positive-control test's reference compiler is the one non-default consumer, matching PCREC_MAX_VM_EMIT_CODE_BYTES's own precedent) -- [LIM-OVR] 2026-09-22: override was BUILD_D, rendering '-D' and falsely implying no caller lever exists, when --max-auto-dfa-elems IS exactly that lever; FLAG_D is the honest token for this two-lever shape
[M4.5b]: the VM emitter's own node-count size backstop
[M4.5c]: how many times a bounded repeat may replicate a body with a choice point
[K22]: total replication product along a chain of nested bounded repeats — a literal alias of PCREC_MAX_VM_NODES, not tuned separately
[ENG-BREP]: the counter rung's default unroll factor K, overridden by --unroll=N
[ENG-BREP]: byte-consuming positions a quantifier body may have before possessify.c declines it
[ENG-BREP]: capturing groups a quantifier body may contain before revdet.c declines the reverse-deterministic rung
[OPT-ALTCLS] stage 2: how deep prefix factoring may recurse into a group that just split
FIX-1/K5: the largest {n,m} quantifier count PCRE2 accepts (measured against libpcre2 10.46)
PCRE2's own nested-group depth ceiling (measured); also bounds parser/AST recursion depth
[M6.3]: a named group's name, measured against libpcre2 10.46 (PCRE2 error 148 above it)
a (*VERB) name; PCRE2-internals tier, measured over both name tables
(*LIMIT_MATCH=N) and friends: the accumulator magnitude PCRE2 refuses at (UINT32_MAX/10 - 1)
\p{...}/\P{...} property name, in SIGNIFICANT characters (measured against libpcre2 10.46)
[DD-14 wave G]: per-call-site AST-node splice budget before a call linkage is forced
[DD-14 wave G]: total added AST nodes across every spliced call site in one compile
[ENG-ABS]: the optional anchored match-here machine's own DFA state ceiling, lower than the mandatory pair's

[ART-SIZE]/D84: emitted C bytes OUTSIDE table initializers; --max-emit-code-bytes ALSO raises it per-compile (raise-only); -D moves the built-in default (run_size_term.sh's reference-compiler consumer) -- [LIM-OVR] 2026-09-22: override was BUILD_D ('never a caller lever'), false given --max-emit-code-bytes; FLAG_D names the two-lever shape honestly

[FINDINGS] B1: the largest count one `row` of an analysis data block may carry (2^40); over it the block is refused by this name at parse, never truncated. Keeps the byte-rate normalization's product (count x 10^6 <= 2^60) and every later derivation inside uint64_t (docs/design/findings/design.md §2.3, §2.5, §9)

[FINDINGS] B5: the most `row` lines one `cpfreq` data block may carry (distinct code points); over it the block is refused by this name at parse, never truncated. With PCREC_MAX_FIND_COUNT it bounds every derived byte count below 2^58, so the encode-utf8 sum cannot wrap before its own ceiling test (docs/design/findings/design.md §8.3, §9)

[FINDINGS] B1: the byte-rate floor, in parts per million — the rate a byte a data block never counted (or counted too rarely) is given by the normalization, so no rate reader ever believes a byte IMPOSSIBLE and selects on a certainty it does not have. The shipped default's own floor, which is why it normalizes to itself (docs/design/findings/design.md §0.7, §2.5)

[FINDINGS] B2: the most bundles an analysis chain may hold before its built-in default terminal (the selected bundle and each `include` it follows); a longer chain is refused by this name, never cut (docs/design/findings/design.md §4.3, §8.3, §9)

[FINDINGS] B2: the largest text an analysis is read from — an -I DIR/<name>.rxt file, or a library caller's analysis_source; over it the text is refused by this name before it is parsed, never truncated (docs/design/findings/design.md §8.3, §9)

[OPT-4]: the advisory --warn-emit-bytes default (never refuses, 0 disables) ALSO settable per-compile; -D moves the built-in default -- [LIM-OVR] 2026-09-22: override was BUILD_D; --warn-emit-bytes is a real (non-raise-only) caller lever on top of the -D-movable default, the same two-lever shape as the raise-only rows above, now FLAG_D

[ART-SIZE]/D84: the whole comment-excluded artifact; --max-emit-bytes ALSO raises it per-compile (raise-only); -D moves the built-in default -- [LIM-OVR] 2026-09-22: override was BUILD_D ('never a caller lever'), false given --max-emit-bytes; FLAG_D names the two-lever shape honestly
[ART-SIZE]: the emitted-size knee above which the unroll-K size term evaluates the ladder at all
[ART-SIZE]: the unroll-K ladder's MATERIALITY BAR -- a smaller K ships only if its artifact is at most this percent of the default K's bytes
D51: default backtrack-resumption budget; --step-budget=N overrides per compile
D49: default forward-only-work budget, a separate counter from steps; --work-budget=N overrides
D73: default resume-stack capacity for the UNBOUNDED-depth class; --backtrack-frames=N overrides
D73: default trail capacity paired with VM_DEFAULT_RESUME_FRAMES
[M4.6a]: clamp ceiling for the BOUNDED-depth class's exact auto-sizing under --backtrack-frames
[M4.6a]: trail's own clamp ceiling, paired with VM_MAX_AUTO_RESUME_FRAMES
[ENG-ISL]: fewest literal alternatives an alternation island is built for at all; below it vm_alt's chain emits the alternation
[ENG-ISL]: fewest literal alternatives an island that PUSHES is built for -- one whose alternatives are not prefix-free, so its candidate chain has a second entry and the artifact stays framed
[ENG-ISL]: most literal words an alternation's subtree may enumerate to before the island declines (the bench's widest altwide rung is 4096)
[ENG-ISL]: total literal bytes across every enumerated word; bounds the cross product of concatenated alternations, which is exponential in principle
[ENG-ISL]: alternation NESTING the enumeration may recurse through; a pattern controls this depth, so it is a bound on pcrec's own C stack (D10/R-2)
[ENG-ISL]: measured marginal emitted-code bytes per alternation-island trie node, for the island-vs-chain size comparison
[ENG-ISL]: measured marginal emitted-code bytes per AST node of the subtree vm_alt's serial chain would emit instead

[ENG-ISL]: how many times the chain's estimated emitted size the island may reach before it declines; on the ESTIMATOR the two populations separate at 2.60 against 4.02, and 2 is validated by the random size census (0 refused, max artifact growth 1.03x) rather than argued

[CC-DIFF] STEP 2: emitted VM program bytes at or below which the entry chain is inlined into the three _in entries (rung FORWARD); above it one shared out-of-line body (rung SHARED). --vm-entry-shape=N overrides the decision outright
src/facts/kset.c: how many offsets past the candidate start the k-set walk (the kset_walk fact) may carry
src/opt/prefix_k.c: how many offsets the selected offset-set prefilter candidate may carry

src/opt/mrl.c: the minimum-width analysis' saturation ceiling (== PCREC_W_UNBOUNDED), shared directly by src/opt/callgraph.c's fixpoints since [PATFACTS] step 3.6 retired that file's own CG_EXP_INF re-declaration of the same value

[OPT-5]: how many scan edges one DFA machine may carry — src/opt/scanedge.c takes the longest chains first, src/gen/emit_dfa.c sizes its array by it; since [OPT-EDGE] STEP 1 an edge costs NO compare on the emitted loop's generic path (the shared sentinel), so this is an emitted-bytes budget awaiting a measured re-choice

[K50]: fixed buffer size for the caller-startpos boundary guard's rendered C expression (src/core/internal.h's pcrec_startpos_guard_text; four call sites in the two emitters). Sized by the ENCODING BACKEND's own guard text, not by the pattern — enc_utf8.c's is 46 bytes with the @-placeholders expanded, so this is K38-precedent margin over the longest a backend could plausibly spell; overflow is a loud internal error, never a truncated half-guard

[OPT-5] precondition (5): the SHORTEST bounded counted-class run src/opt/scanedge.c will collapse into a scan edge (the unbounded self-loop is admitted at any length). MEASURED 2026-09-04 against the STEP 1.1 loop -- studies/scan_edge_ladder/run_floor.sh, 3 runs x 15 rounds, edge vs -fno-scan-edge on the same pattern: at m=2, 3 and 4 the two arms are NOT separated by more than the per-round range on either family, so D77 no-gap-no-move keeps this at 2; the only resolvable separation is m=8 nullable, edge/noedge 0.9855 median [IQR 0.0243]. The edge SIZE win is unconditional and is the standing reason to admit m=2. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-21 on the fixed harness (I-82, D117): 0 of 16 cells separate, still keeping this at 2

[OPT-REQPOS] tier 2b: the LONGEST necessary literal run the pre-check will compare, in POSITIONS ([OPT-LITSCAN] S4 C3: a position is one byte or a two-member cube, and a masked window of 8 positions is compared by the run compare's rows) (src/opt/reqbyte.c derives the run, src/gen/emit_dfa.c sizes the emitted memcmp by it). A longer run is TRUNCATED to its lowest-frequency window of this length containing the scan byte, never split into two compares (reqpos_2b.md §2.4 item 3, Frank's ruling 2026-09-22). 8 is where gcc lowers a constant-length memcmp to ONE word load and one compare with no call out of line, measured on both this box's gcc-16 and the reference gcc-15.2 (reqpos_2b.md §3.2); above it the compare decomposes and a second mechanism's cost question opens, which is the D77 trigger for moving this

[VAR]: the longest selector `${name}` may carry. A name is emitted into the artifact as part of an identifier (the internal <PREFIX>_VAR_<NAME> index macro) and into rx_info's names table, so it is bounded for the same reason -p is (PCREC_MAX_PREFIX_LEN); 64 is well above any name a caller would write and well under PCREC_MAX_EMIT_NAME_LEN's own margin

[VAR]: how deep a `${name:-word}` operator's WORD may nest further `${...}` expansions. variables_common.md §1.7: nesting is permitted in the word position only and the bound is COMPILE-time, so an over-deep template is a compile error and no run-time recursion is introduced in either consumer. 8 is a fallback-chain depth no real caller approaches; the parser recurses once per level, so this also bounds that recursion

[OPT-REQPOS] tier 2b: how much of a necessary literal run the ANALYSIS tracks before truncating it (src/opt/reqbyte.c's RbRun). Bounds the walk's per-frame state on a pattern whose literal is as long as the pattern — this project has segfaulted its own compiler on a 20,000-byte literal — and every truncation is SOUND in the only direction that matters, because a prefix of a necessary contiguous run is itself a necessary contiguous run. Sized at four times PCREC_MAX_REQ_RUN_EMIT so the window choice above is EXACT for every run length the shipped corpus and the bench contain (longest measured 11, docs/dev/optloop/reqpos_census.md §1.1)

[OPT-LITSCAN] S4 C3: the necessary run's admission floor in INFORMATION, the sum over its positions of popcount(K) (8 for an exact byte, 7 for a two-member cube; src/facts/facts.c). RULED, not fitted: today's exact floor of two bytes restated in the ranking's own unit, so every exact run admitted before is admitted (n >= 2 iff 8n >= 16); three caseless letters (21) clear it and two (14) do not, which matches every measured customer (4-6 letters, litscan_s4.md §7). It is the necessary run's floor only; D127's L >= 3 is the VM literal run's, in positions. Moving it takes a census plus a cell (D77)

[OPT-LITSCAN] S4 C3: the largest member set one position of the necessary run may have (src/facts/req.c's walk and its alternation hull). RULED: every position must be a scan candidate and the emitted scan has two arms, one stream (memchr) and two (the pair leapfrog, O-55's measured form); a wider set is a third arm no cell asks for (D77). -fno-req-run-fold sets the walk's bound to 1, the single byte

[UCP] U1 (ucp_design.md §6, D130 Q3): the most code-point INTERVALS a UCP set (\d, \w, a POSIX class under (*UCP)/--ucp) may have, after clamping to the encoding's universe, and still be built today; a wider one is REFUSED by name until a kit-sized route exists ([CLS-TREE] S4 for the VM, [UCP] U3 for the DFA) -- at today's cost `\w+` under UCP utf8 is a 330 KB, 66 s compile. 128 sits between the widest set the ruling ships (\p{Nd}, 71 intervals) and the narrowest it refuses (UCP [:punct:], ~207), so the measured rule reproduces exactly the ruled list; tests/ucp pins the partition. Every set under -e byte clamps far below it

[UCP] U2 (ucp_design.md §2.4): the most DISTINCT context sets one DFA machine may read (the word set of a \b/\B, a one-character lookaround's set, the newline set of (?m)^/$, the encoding's non-start set) -- the width of a context ATOM's membership vector; a machine over it is DECLINED like a state-cap overflow (auto routes it to the VM, --engine=dfa refuses). The corpus's widest machine reads 3

[UCP] U2 (ucp_design.md §2.4, H4): the most context ATOMS (realized membership vectors over a machine's context sets, the empty vector included) one DFA machine may carry -- the width of DState.up[], of the seed families and of every per-state class view; a machine over it is DECLINED like a state-cap overflow (auto routes it to the VM, --engine=dfa refuses), never truncated. Every shipped class-axis machine realizes at most 4
src/parse/mod_recursion.c: saturation ceiling for a (?N)/(?+N)/(?-N) recursion-call number
src/parse/mod_backrefs.c: saturation ceiling for a \N/\g{N} backreference number
src/parse/mod_lookaround.c: fixed buffer size for the §2.5/§2.7 lookaround diagnostic text
